To conquer, defeat, overcome, vanquish, subjugate; जयति तुलामधिरूढो
 भास्वानपि जलदपटलानि
To surpass, excel; गर्जितानन्तरां वृष्टिं सौभाग्येन जिगाय सा

To win (by conquest, in gambling or in a law-suit), acquire by conquest;
 प्रागजीयत घृणा ततो मही
To curb, restrain, control, conquer (as passions).

To be victorious, be supreme or pre-eminent (generally used in benedictory
 stanzas or salutations); जयतु जयतु महाराजः (in dramas); स
 जयति परिणद्धः शक्तिभिः शक्तिनाथः
To overcome or get the better of (as a disease &c.).

To expect from (with abl.). ━Caus. (जापयति) To cause
 to win or conquer. ━Desid. (जिगीषति) To wish to win, acquire
 or excel, to vie with, emulate, to seek for; चलति नयान्न जिगीषतां
 हि चेतः
